Checklist

Base Set

See 2016 Topps for the complete checklist.

Parallels

Each set will contain 13 randomly selected Gold Refractor parallels each serial-numbered to five.

SuperFractors

Each set will contain two randomly selected one-of-one SuperFractors.

NOTE: The 185 players who appeared in both the 2016 Topps and 2016 Topps Chrome base sets will not have a Sapphire Chrome SuperFractor, leaving the 515 cards below. Topps has said that only 500 cards will have SuperFractors. As to which of the 15 cards listed below will be excluded, is currently unknown.
